cases.risk: Auto-wrapped node labels lose repeated, leading and trailing spaces, changing mathematical notation
cases.red: node --test tests/cut19.test.mjs fails against exact Cut18 src/diagram_layout.mjs with label reconstruction mismatch
cases.fix: Keep all whitespace characters when splitting visual tspan lines. Never trim author text at word breaks.
cases.green: Both new Node tests pass, including multiple spaces, leading/trailing spaces and explicit line breaks. Browser verifies SVG node tspans concatenate to original text.

cases.risk: Text, node and morphism property editor is single-line even though JSON supports manual line breaks
cases.red: Cut18 has a single-line input for label editing; browser_cut19.py asserts textarea exists
cases.fix: Provide a spellcheck-free multiline field with keyboard focus safety and explicit commit-on-change semantics; explain in UI
cases.green: Browser type/edit and final JSON round-trip exercise text and morphism labels with embedded newline and spaces.

cases.risk: Raw SVG text and morphism labels treat explicit newline as whitespace rather than distinct visual line
cases.red: Cut18 plain text and morphism use one SVG text node with literal newline, no tspan lines
cases.fix: Create explicitly positioned tspans at font-relative line spacing, retaining author text in JSON; keep single-line output structure
cases.green: browser_cut19.py downloads SVG, asserts visible distinct tspans and verbatim JSON text. TikZ is disabled when multiline cannot be represented.

cases.risk: Thousands of completely offscreen text/diagram-node elements still rebuild DOM and worsen interaction responsiveness
cases.red: Cut18 benchmark: 2520 object-related SVG elements; 43.8 ms median rebuild
cases.fix: Conservative font-size-aware text bounds and existing exact approximate node box bounds allow viewport rejection without deleting scene objects
cases.green: Cut19 benchmark: 120 object-related SVG elements; 8.75 ms median; full raw 12-sample data retained.

cases.risk: Viewport culling could hide arrows whose semantic endpoints are offscreen but whose path crosses the viewport
cases.red: Potential new second-order regression from node culling, not an observed Cut18 defect
cases.fix: Cull node boxes individually, never implicitly discard dependent morphism paths; maintain same semantic refs
cases.green: browser_cut19.py checks crossing morphism path remains visible, hidden endpoint nodes are absent from SVG, all objects preserved in JSON and object list.

cases.risk: Historical regression tests depend on one-line label input topology and may falsely hang after correct UI change
cases.red: Cut07 property-suite timed out looking for an input after new multiline property controls were introduced
cases.fix: Update property-suite and TeX compiler test selectors to find textarea, retaining unchanged behavioral assertions
cases.green: Cut07 full properties suite, Cut03 browser suite and actual pdflatex exports pass with updated harness.
